text.zh-CN:
多囊卵巢综合征涉及激素、排卵和代谢，表现不只是卵巢上有囊泡。

- 常见月经间隔长、痤疮、多毛或怀孕困难，每个人表现不同。
- 没有卵巢囊泡样改变也可能患病，不能只看超声下结论。
- 部分当前英文资料也使用 PMOS 名称；本条沿用熟悉的 PCOS。
text.en:
PCOS affects hormones, ovulation and metabolism, not simply the appearance of the ovaries.

- Irregular periods, acne, excess hair or fertility difficulty vary between people.
- It can occur without cyst-like ovarian changes.
- Some current English sources also use PMOS; this entry retains the familiar PCOS name.

text.zh-CN:
确切原因尚未完全弄清。

- 遗传因素可能参与，家族中有类似问题值得告诉医生。
- 雄激素作用偏高可影响毛发、皮肤和排卵。
- 胰岛素抵抗指身体对调节血糖的胰岛素反应变弱，可伴代谢问题。
text.en:
The exact cause remains uncertain.

- Family susceptibility may contribute.
- Higher androgen activity can affect hair, skin and ovulation.
- Insulin resistance means reduced response to the hormone regulating glucose and can affect metabolism.

text.zh-CN:
急性不适不能都归因于多囊。

- 突然剧烈腹痛、昏厥或大量出血，应立即寻求评估。
- 可能怀孕且伴腹痛或出血时，需要排除妊娠相关急症。
- 这些不是用来确诊多囊的表现，不能等待常规激素复查。
text.en:
Acute illness should not automatically be attributed to PCOS.

- Sudden severe abdominal pain, collapse or heavy bleeding needs urgent assessment.
- Possible pregnancy with pain or bleeding needs exclusion of pregnancy emergencies.
- These are safety warnings, not diagnostic features of PCOS.

text.zh-CN:
治疗目标可从最困扰的问题开始。

- 长期月经稀少、闭经、多毛或痤疮明显，应预约评估。
- 准备怀孕或已经尝试而未成功，可讨论排卵与生育支持。
- 情绪、体重或外观困扰影响生活时，也属于值得就医的内容。
text.en:
Start care with the concerns affecting you most.

- Persistent infrequent periods, absent periods, excess hair or significant acne warrants review.
- Discuss ovulation and fertility when planning pregnancy.
- Mood, weight or appearance-related distress also deserves care.

text.zh-CN:
没有单一检查能确诊全部情况。

- 医生结合月经史、体征及激素化验判断。
- 超声观察卵巢和子宫内膜，但不是有囊泡就等于患病。
- 青少年评估有特殊要求，不宜照搬成人的超声判定。
text.en:
No single test establishes every diagnosis.

- Menstrual history, examination and hormone tests are considered together.
- Ultrasound assesses ovaries and uterine lining but is not diagnostic by itself.
- Adolescents need a different assessment from adults.

text.zh-CN:
相似表现需要寻找其他解释。

- 月经迟来应考虑妊娠等可能，不能自动归因于已知多囊。
- 多毛、痤疮和月经改变也可见于其他激素问题。
- 医生根据发展速度和化验决定排查范围，不需要自行做所有激素检查。
text.en:
Similar symptoms can have other explanations.

- A late period can indicate pregnancy even with known PCOS.
- Other hormone conditions can cause acne, hair growth or cycle changes.
- The pattern and tests guide targeted investigation rather than every possible test.

text.zh-CN:
治疗按月经、皮肤、代谢或生育目标组合。

- 不备孕时可用适合的激素方案管理月经和部分皮肤症状。
- 代谢风险通过饮食、活动及必要药物处理。
- 有生育需要时采用促排卵等专门方案，并非所有人都需要手术。
text.en:
Treatment is tailored to menstrual, skin, metabolic and fertility goals.

- Suitable hormonal treatment can manage cycles and some skin symptoms when not trying to conceive.
- Lifestyle and selected medicines address metabolic risk.
- Fertility care may involve ovulation treatment; surgery is not universal.

text.zh-CN:
同一种药可能服务于不同目标。

- 激素避孕药可管理月经，但备孕目标与之不同。
- 二甲双胍等可针对胰岛素抵抗，使用它不等于一定患糖尿病。
- 抗雄激素药可能影响妊娠，需核对避孕和备孕安排；地区批准范围不同。
text.en:
A medicine can have more than one purpose.

- Hormonal contraception can regulate cycles but differs from fertility treatment.
- Metformin may address insulin resistance without implying a diabetes diagnosis.
- Anti-androgens require pregnancy-safety and contraception discussion; approvals vary regionally.

text.zh-CN:
饮食关注长期代谢健康。

- 选择能坚持的均衡饮食，不必把所有主食都删掉。
- 体重偏高时可讨论温和、可持续的体重管理。
- 现有患者资料没有给出适合所有人的唯一多囊食谱，补充剂不能替代随访。
text.en:
Diet supports long-term metabolic health.

- Use a sustainable balanced pattern rather than excluding all carbohydrate foods.
- Discuss gradual weight management when appropriate.
- The reviewed sources do not establish one universal PCOS diet; supplements do not replace care.

text.zh-CN:
记录和支持能帮助长期管理。

- 记录月经日期、异常出血和正在用的药。
- 把活动融入日常，并根据体力逐渐增加。
- 皮肤、多毛和情绪问题可分别寻求支持，不需要等到备孕才处理。
text.en:
Tracking and support help ongoing care.

- Record periods, unusual bleeding and medicines.
- Build activity gradually into daily routines.
- Skin, hair and emotional concerns can be addressed before fertility becomes a priority.

text.zh-CN:
年龄和生育计划会改变处理。

- 青少年月经和激素仍在变化，诊断需要专门评估。
- 备孕前核对所有药物，尤其影响激素或体重的药。
- 体重不高也可能患病，不能用身材排除多囊。
text.en:
Age and pregnancy plans alter care.

- Adolescents need assessment appropriate to ongoing hormonal development.
- Review all medicines before conception, especially hormone or weight treatments.
- PCOS can occur without higher body weight.

text.zh-CN:
这是需要按目标随访的长期问题。

- 症状可改善，但不同阶段可能需要调整方案。
- 复诊关注月经、皮肤、血糖血压及个人生育计划。
- 许多人仍可怀孕，生育困难不等于永久无法怀孕。
text.en:
Long-term care should track individual goals.

- Symptoms can improve while plans change over time.
- Review cycles, skin, glucose, blood pressure and fertility intentions.
- Many affected people can become pregnant; difficulty is not certainty of permanent infertility.

text.zh-CN:
长期随访需要关注相关健康风险。

- 血糖异常和心血管风险因素可能增加。
- 长期排卵不规律可影响子宫内膜，需要讨论保护和异常出血。
- 睡眠、焦虑和抑郁问题也应纳入随访；不是所有人都会出现。
text.en:
Long-term follow-up should monitor associated health risks.

- Glucose abnormalities and cardiovascular risk factors may increase.
- Irregular ovulation can affect the uterine lining and bleeding patterns.
- Sleep and emotional health also deserve attention.

text.zh-CN:
目前没有保证防止发生的方法。

- 保持适合的饮食和活动，有助控制部分相关代谢风险。
- 月经长期异常时及早评估，避免只靠临时催经。
- 定期复查与阶段性调整治疗，可减少遗漏长期健康问题。
text.en:
There is no guaranteed way to prevent PCOS.

- Suitable eating and activity can help manage related metabolic risk.
- Seek assessment for persistent cycle changes.
- Regular follow-up helps identify and address longer-term concerns.

limitations.zh-CN: 原创简明医学信息草稿；所列来源是待逐项核对的参考依据，不表示完成系统综述、独立双源论证或医生审核。
limitations.en: Original educational draft. Listed references await claim-level verification; no systematic review, independent dual-source confirmation or clinical sign-off is claimed.

terminology_note.zh-CN: NHS当前页面使用PMOS；其他来源仍用PCOS。保留稳定ID与双别名，地区命名尚待审核。
terminology_note.en: NHS currently uses PMOS while other sources retain PCOS. A stable ID and both aliases are retained; regional naming needs review.
